verdict.rationale: Reflect's first-party docs describe an in-app AI palette (cmd+j) with built-in prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items' over your notes, plus custom saved prompts. You can also chat with filtered sets of notes to ask questions and extract information, with GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet selectable, which delivers AI insights from your own data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features, and any evidence of proactive or automatic suggestions (all AI use appears user-invoked).
